info.title: Dynamis Code Apps Template API
info.description: Stable v1 REST contract. Additive changes preserve authorization, ordering, errors, and side effects. Breaking changes require a new version or published migration window. Query collections use bounded filters, literal search, deterministic sorting, and opaque query-bound cursors. Errors use RFC 9457 Problem Details. See docs/api.md for the human-readable reference.

Limited to 10 attempts per source address per minute by default.

get.description: Owners and admins with resources:read can view separate currency totals. Dates are inclusive workspace-local calendar dates; presets use the workspace time zone. Amounts are exact decimal strings in minor units.
Owners, admins, and members with resources:read can list entries, newest first, 100 per page. Filters combine with AND; dates are inclusive.

post.description: Owners, admins, and members with resources:write can record an immutable entry. Omit occurredOn to use today in the workspace time zone.
Owners and admins with resources:write can void an entry with an optional reason.

get.description: Workspace members with resources:read can list entries and their price options. Archived entries are excluded unless includeArchived=true.

post.description: An owner or admin with resources:write can create an entry with at least one price atomically.
An owner or admin with resources:write can add a fixed or manual price to an active entry. Amount is a non-negative decimal string for fixed options and null or omitted for manual options.

get.description: Returns a deterministic page. Archived clients are excluded. Without sort, the page is newest first. Sort orders by one field, with empty values last and ties broken by client ID in the sort direction. Filters combine with AND. Total counts every client the filters and archived selector match. Clients have no free-text search in v1.

delete.description: Permanently deletes an archived custom field. Its value is cleared from every client, its choice options are removed, and its slot is freed, all in one transaction. Active fields are refused with 409. Owners and admins only.

ClientSort.name: sort
ClientSort.description: Optional sort field: a common field (displayName, email, phone, notes, createdAt, updatedAt) or a custom field's short ID. A leading minus sorts descending. Number fields sort numerically. Text sorts by bytes. Empty values sort last.

ClientFilter.name: filter
ClientFilter.description: Optional condition as field:operator:value. May repeat; conditions combine with AND. A field may repeat in REST v1. is_empty takes an empty value and matches absent, null, or empty values. Common text fields (displayName, email, phone, notes) take equals or contains. Custom fields are named by short ID. Text takes equals or contains, case-insensitive for ASCII letters. Number and date take equals, before, after, or between (value from,to, inclusive). createdAt and updatedAt accept RFC3339 timestamp values with equals, before, after, or between. Before and after are strict. Yes/no takes equals with true or false. Single choice takes equals with one or more comma-separated option IDs. Equals on a number compares canonical decimal text, so 10.0 matches 10. Operators are documented in docs/api.md.

ClientArchived.name: archived
ClientArchived.description: Which clients the list shows. active (the default) excludes archived clients, archived shows only archived clients, and all shows both. Pages keep this value.

SCIMUserId.name: userId
SCIMUserId.description: SCIM resource id: the user's short ID. The IdP externalId, malformed, unknown, and foreign IDs return the same SCIM not-found error.
